feeds.title: Worship Matters
feeds.description: Bob Kauflin writes this blog primarily for those who plan and lead worship in song. He serves as the Director of Sovereign Grace Music for Sovereign Grace Churches. This blog is a complete resource for music, worship, & more.

feeds.title: Worship Leader Magazine
feeds.description: The Worship Leader's mission is to exalt God and join those called in sung prayer and worship with the express purpose of building the House of Prayer. They are known for their podcasts, The Walk, Conferences, their magazines, from top authors, artists & songwriters, and more.

feeds.title: WorshipIdeas.com
feeds.description: Don Chapman's passion is Church, music and technology, and he blends all three into resource websites devoted to contemporary worship. WorshipIdeas blog consists of Articles, News, Guides and much more on praise, worship, music and everything related.

feeds.title: Experiencing Worship
feeds.description: Experiencing Worship is a complete worship resource founded by Stephen M. Newman. He provides training resources for all who desire a better understanding of true worship. The Worship Resource Free worship materials to help you with your worship music needs, Worship articles and more.

feeds.title: Worship Tutorials
feeds.description: Worship Tutorials exist to equip and inspire worship leaders and musicians. Our vision is excellent and authentic worship in every church in the world. Browse the free Worship Tutorials video library to learn songs, tips for worship leaders, review gear, guitar lessons & more.

feeds.title: Worship HeartCries
feeds.description: Worship HeartCries consists of weekly encouragements and insights into biblical worship written by Dr Ed Steele. He preaches and explains the Bible through Bible study and his blog, breaking it down for easy understanding.

feeds.title: Worship Leaders University
feeds.description: Mark Cole is a Jesus follower, worship leader, musician, pastor, teacher, and pickleball player. Find notes on worship, music, God, leadership, church and life by Worship Leaders University and read from topics about worship, songs, god and more.

feeds.title: Spacious Faith
feeds.description: Rev. Joanna Harader is the author of Spacious Faith Blog. Spacious Faith is a community of Christians creatively practising faith, spiritual practices, worship pieces, and general ponderings. Read about worship liturgy & other writings from Jonna Harader.

feeds.title: ChurchLeaders » Worship
feeds.description: Church Leaders is dedicated to resourcing, informing, and connecting a community of church leaders for impact worldwide. Worship & creative leaders from every denomination find ideas, encouragement, inspiration, teaching tips, and support they need here.

feeds.title: EasyWorship Blog
feeds.description: EasyWorship is a church presentation software with user-friendly features. It's powerful, dependable, & creative. Experience worship, the easy way. Find pro tips, the word, worship, and all updates on EasyWorship here.

feeds.title: Worship Ministry Training Blog
feeds.description: Worship Ministry Training is a blog for worship leaders. A training resource helping worship leaders and worship teams excel musically, theologically and pastorally. Providing practical training to worship leaders through articles, podcasts, training resources and more.

feeds.title: Worship Offerings Blog
feeds.description: Rev.Gord Waldie is an ordained minister in the United Church of Canada. He has written a collection of worship resources, allowing anyone to use it. Find an array of prayers, preaching and more here for different occasions and events.

feeds.title: Worship Center
feeds.description: Worship Center in Lancaster, PA, invites individuals to follow Jesus, grow with others, and serve the world. They foster a sense of home, welcoming all ages to be growing followers of Jesus who love God and people. With diverse resources, they lead people in worship and spiritual growth.

feeds.title: Jason Sears Blog
feeds.description: Jason Sears is the Worship Pastor at Oak Mountain Presbyterian Church. Oak Mountain is a contemporary-style PCA church in the suburbs of Birmingham, Alabama. All recaps of Sunday's service, praise and worship songs on Spotify, tweets, and more can be found here.

feeds.title: Worship Quest Ministries Blog
feeds.description: Worship Quest Ministries encourages worship renewal and spiritual formation by providing training and resources for the global Christian church. Worship Quest Ministries Blogs are more than just blogs. They are devotionals to use as we join the quest of being spiritually formed by the Spirit through our worship.

feeds.title: Worship Drummer Blog
feeds.description: Worship Drummer is a Canada-based blog founded by Jon in 2010, focused on inspiring and equipping church and worship drummers. It features gear reviews, tutorials, interviews, event updates, and podcasts aimed at building a global community of drummers in worship settings.

feeds.title: Alabama Worship Blog
feeds.description: Alabama Worship Blog seeks to help identify and equip your church with any Worship Leadership needs to proclaim the gospel through music. That includes music, worship events, instrumental needs, sound consultations, networking and more. Read the blog to get updates.

feeds.title: Equipped Worship Blog
feeds.description: Equipped Worship exists to support ministry leaders in building up the Church. We desire to equip the saints for the work of the ministry. Learnings, teachings and tips & tricks for worship leaders and pastors can be found on the blog.

feeds.title: AllWorship Blog
feeds.description: AllWorship is a not-for-profit Christian radio station exclusively on the Internet that provides commercial-free worship music in four formats: contemporary worship, praise & worship, Spanish worship, and instrumental worship. Find preachings by Micheal, who helps uniquely see worship and god, and Christian Worship Music.

feeds.title: Renewing Worship
feeds.description: Renewing Worship is a consultant for the Baptist State Convention of North Carolina with a passion to help churches throughout the world to renew their worship. Kenny Lamm is the author of this blog and worship minister. Read articles about worship, choir, churches and more.

feeds.title: My Song In The Night
feeds.description: My Song In The Night exists to help express words of worship & testimony through songs & stories. They teach how to share your testimony, faith, and story and how it is one part of God's story. From Church Communications, Coping, Exhortations And Musings, interviews, checkups, music till so much more.

feeds.title: Dan Wilt Blog
feeds.description: Dan Wilt is an author, speaker & musician, worship leader, poet, songwriter, and encourager of Christians in many streams of the Church. He explores topics such as finding our identity in the love of God, following the way of Jesus in times like these, worship, the Spirit-responsive life, and creativity on his blog.

feeds.title: Ponder Anew Blog
feeds.description: Patheos is an online destination to engage in the global dialogue about religion and explore the world's beliefs. It brings together faith communities, academics, and the broader public. Its vision is to represent evangelical thought and to articulate the gospel in a multireligious marketplace of ideas that shape the church.

feeds.title: Worship.com
feeds.description: Worship exists to glorify God, inviting people to pursue God wholeheartedly and into lifestyles that are living sacrifices that reflect God's worship as a way of life. Documentaries, music, worship, worship songs and more on our blog to read and hear from.

feeds.title: Zac Hicks
feeds.description: Worship. Church. Theology. Culture.

feeds.title: Calvin Institute of Christian Worship
feeds.description: The Calvin Institute of Christian Worship - for the study and renewal of worship - is based in Michigan and aims to promote the scholarly study of the theology, history, practice and renewal of worship in local congregations. Find the latest articles, audio, photos, video, and other resources.

feeds.title: Still Waters Blog
feeds.description: Still Waters is a creative worship and prayer station idea where churches and ministries come together and are led by the Spirit as the landscape changes. Theresa helps us understand the Bible better by writing this blog and relating each chapter in her own words.

feeds.title: Worship Team Coach Blog
feeds.description: Worship Teamcoach Helps You Equip a Strong Team That Leads Engaging Worship. Learn How to Lead, Teach, and Unleash a Healthy Worship Team. Feel free to check out Articles, Podcasts & Posts on our blog.

feeds.title: Heart of Worship Blog
feeds.description: Heart of Worship is meant to encourage & draw you closer to God through a personal relationship with Him. This blog will deal with topics such as relationships, marriage, being led by God, godly friendships, godly living and more.

feeds.title: Worship Leader Institute Blog
feeds.description: Worship Leader Insti

feeds.title: Worship Leader Coaching Blog
feeds.description: Worship leaders are often trained as musicians but expected to be ministers. At Worship Leader Coaching (WLC), we help worship leaders develop the leadership and pastoral skills needed to lead their teams and churches. Read articles and reviews of books on worship leaders.

feeds.title: Essential Worship Blog
feeds.description: Essential Worship exists to resource worship leaders and teams, making it easier for the local church to discover and adopt new songs. Find Song Sessions, Gatherings, Tutorials and more. We provide exclusive song content. Read the blog for ideas and inspiration.

feeds.title: Messy Worship Blog
feeds.description: Emily is the author of Messy Worship. Learn about God with the Bible & a Blog. This blog helps you seek god in simple, everyday moments, overcome obstacles, transform, learn and practice swapping perfection into grace.

feeds.title: WorshipReady.com Blog
feeds.description: Worship Ready is an ultimate praise & worship chord charts resource, bringing accurate worship chord charts. Read various worship, music ministry and church leadership blogs written by leading worship artists, worship leaders, pastors and church leaders.

feeds.title: The Worship Initiative Blog
feeds.description: The Worship Initiative helps learn popular songs, instruments, and the word, written by some friends at Desiring God ministries. Get video training and free access to hundreds of online charts using the Setlist Builder.

feeds.title: Worship Vocalist Blog
feeds.description: The Worship Vocalist is a community of worship leaders and singers committed to pursuing craft and improving vocal skills, so we can more effectively minister to our congregations and create settings for them. Learn how to add essence to your worship by reading the blog.
